purpose: Teach: 改ざん/急騰/募る/整然と/名著/同好/真下/アーム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データの、本気で、絶対、改ざん、絶対、絶対、許さんぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I won't tolerate data falsification. Not under any circumstances. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Leans forward slightly on the opening name. Each condition lands with deliberate weight. No room for misunderstanding. Not angry — exacting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究機材費の、本気で、絶対、急騰、絶対、研究室、絶対、対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The equipment costs have spiked, but the lab is managing it. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, careful precision. Acknowledges the problem without excuse. Steady eye contact. Measured pace. The tone of someone reporting back on a task taken seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究者、本気で、絶対、募る、絶対、活動、絶対、続けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep recruiting co-researchers. Keep the work moving forward. That's what I need from you.
lines.style: Clear instruction, not negotiation. Calm but commanding. Pauses after each direction to let it land. Assumes compliance without doubt.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究資料、本気で、絶対、整然と、絶対、整理、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The research materials are being organized systematically. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Conscientious and detailed. Slightly formal. Speaks as though checking off a list of responsibilities, each one handled with care. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 分野の、本気で、絶対、名著、絶対、読み込め、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Read the foundational texts in your field. Deep reading. I need you to know them.
lines.style: Quiet insistence, not loud demand. Settles the expectation as though it's already fact. Measured. The voice of someone who knows what builds a researcher.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学生同士の、本気で、絶対、同好、絶対、会、絶対、参加しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm attending the student research seminars regularly. Thank you for encouraging that.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Delivers the commitment as a quiet statement of fact. Slight warmth underneath the formality — he means it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気for、絶対、真下、絶対、機械室、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the machine room directly below the lab. I need verification it's secure.
lines.style: Specific instruction delivered with deliberate pause. Name the location clearly. Short, actionable. The tone assumes this will be done today.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、ロボット、絶対、アーム、絶対、メンテナンス、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The robot arm in the lab is being maintained properly. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Quiet assurance closing the conversation. Speaks as someone who has already completed the work and is simply reporting. Warm underneath the formality. A small exhale of certainty.
